ps.en: The town decided to [[celebrate]] Mrs. Hale's forty years of teaching with a public [[ceremony]]. A local [[celebrity]], a [[fashionable]] young singer, was invited to perform, and the mayor issued a [[decree]] naming the day after her. Everyone felt [[certain]] that the old hall would be packed.
ps.zh: 小镇决定为黑尔夫人四十年的教学生涯举办一场公开庆典。当地一位名人——时髦的年轻歌手——受邀登台，市长还颁布法令，以她的名字命名这一天。人人都确信老礼堂会座无虚席。

ps.en: Then donations began to [[decline]], and ticket sales [[decreased|decrease]] week after week. Officials [[deemed|deem]] the gala too costly and voted to [[deduct]] money from its budget. Reading the figures, reporters [[deduced|deduce]] that the event had lost public [[favour]]. No one could say with [[certainty]] whether the ceremony would survive.
ps.zh: 随后，捐款开始下滑，票房一周周减少。官员们认为晚会开销太大，投票决定从预算中扣减经费。看到数据，记者们推断这场活动已失去公众支持。典礼能否保住，谁也说不准。

ps.en: Mrs. Hale's former students, who had quietly [[dedicated|dedicate]] their weekends to saving the day, designed scarves in the latest [[fashion]] and sold them online. A charity agreed to [[certify]] every donation with a signed [[certificate]]. The hall filled, the singer sang, and the town celebrated long into the night.
ps.zh: 黑尔夫人的学生们默默把整个周末都投入到挽救这场典礼中。他们设计了最新款式的围巾在网上义卖，一家慈善机构也同意为每笔捐款签发捐赠证书。礼堂坐满了，歌声响起，全镇欢庆到深夜。

ps.en: On a hill [[situated|situate]] above the river, farmers digging a well uncovered a human [[skeleton]]. The [[site]] soon became Professor Venn's [[favorite]] corner of the province. The weather stayed [[favorable]], so her team worked from dawn to dusk, and she would [[sketch]] every bone before it was lifted.
ps.zh: 在河上方的一座小山上，打井的农民挖出了一具人类骸骨。这处遗址很快成了文恩教授在全省最喜爱的角落。天气持续晴好，她的团队从早忙到晚，每块骨头被取出前，她都要先画下速写。

ps.en: Venn was [[skeptical]] of the old claim that the valley had always been empty. These bones, she argued, were the [[embryo]] of a new theory: a town had stood here. Her questions [[elicited|elicit]] sharp replies from the [[elite]] of the field, who insisted the real proof lay [[elsewhere]]. The [[situation]] grew tense at every conference.
ps.zh: 学界旧说认为这片河谷自古无人居住，文恩对此深表怀疑。她主张，这些骸骨是一个新理论的萌芽：这里曾矗立着一座城镇。她的发问引来该领域精英们的尖锐回应，他们坚持说真正的证据在别处。每次学术会议上的气氛都变得紧张起来。

ps.en: Then the carbon report arrived, and its numbers [[embodied|embody]] her claim. Young researchers with a [[thirst]] for discovery joined her, and images of the dig were [[embedded|embed]] in journals across the country. The institute invited her to [[sit]] on its committee, where she urged students to [[embrace]] doubt as a method, not a mood.
ps.zh: 随后碳十四测定报告送达，数据证实了她的推断。渴望探索的年轻研究员纷纷加入，发掘现场的照片刊登在全国各大期刊上。研究所邀请她加入学术委员会，在会上她勉励学生把怀疑当作一种方法，而非情绪。

ps.en: Heavy rain [[threatened|threaten]] the basement of Marlow's old bookshop, and the whole street felt the [[threat]] of losing it. The shop had been his grandfather's bold [[venture]], and it enjoyed [[widespread]] affection. Neighbors formed a committee to [[uphold]] the street's reading tradition.
ps.zh: 大雨威胁着马洛那家旧书店的地下室，整条街都感受到了失去它的危险。这家店是他祖父当年大胆的创业，深受人们喜爱。街坊们成立了委员会，要守护这条街的阅读传统。

ps.en: Their first [[thought]] was repair. Workers [[upgraded|upgrade]] the wiring, [[ventilated|ventilate]] the damp rooms, and put an [[up-to-date]] catalogue online. Marlow [[updated|update]] the accounts every night. The cost, [[though]], [[upset]] him, and a bank clerk advised him to [[withdraw]] his savings before rates fell.
ps.zh: 他们的首要想法是修缮。工人升级了线路，给潮湿的房间排风通风，还把最新的图书目录放到了网上。马洛每晚更新账目。然而开销让他心烦意乱，一位银行职员建议他在利率下跌前取出现金。

ps.en: A [[thorough]] check then revealed rot beneath the floor. A [[thoughtful]] customer, a retired engineer, designed a cheap drainage system with quick [[wit]]. The design helped the shop [[win]] a city preservation grant, and Marlow filled a notebook with everything those weeks had taught him.
ps.zh: 一次彻底检查又发现地板下有朽烂。一位体贴的老主顾——退休工程师——凭机智设计出一套廉价的排水系统。这个设计帮书店赢得了城市保护基金，而马洛把那几周学到的一切都记满了整整一本笔记。

ps.en: The fire at the national [[academy]] [[began|begin]] at midnight. From that [[beginning]], the whole [[academic]] year changed direction. At dawn the dean spoke on [[behalf]] of the staff, promising a full inquiry into the [[incident]].
ps.zh: 国家科学院的大火始于午夜。从那个开端起，整个学年改变了走向。清晨，院长代表全体职工表态，承诺对这起事件展开全面调查。

ps.en: The only [[witness]], a night guard, described a spark near a storage room and noted, [[incidentally]], that the alarms were old. Records showed the [[incidence]] of small lab accidents had been rising, so investigators were [[inclined|incline]] to blame years of budget cuts. In the end, a lab [[accessory]] — a cheap power strip — was named as the cause.
ps.zh: 唯一的目击者是夜班警卫，他描述了储藏室附近的火花，还顺带提到警报器已经老化。记录显示，小型实验室事故的发生率一直在上升，调查人员因此倾向于把原因归咎于多年的经费削减。最终，一个实验室配件——廉价的插线板——被认定为罪魁祸首。

ps.en: The new president, [[inaugurated|inaugurate]] that winter, promised reform. She gave every department an [[incentive]] to report risks early, opened [[access]] to safety funds, and asked everyone to [[accept]] stricter rules. [[Acceptance|acceptance]] came slowly, but change [[accelerated|accelerate]] after a second small fire was stopped in time.
ps.zh: 那年冬天就职的新院长承诺改革。她给每个系设置了及早报告风险的激励，开放了安全经费的申请通道，并要求所有人接受更严格的规定。大家接受得很慢，但在第二起小火被及时扑灭之后，变革加快了脚步。

ps.en: No one [[believed|believe]] in Ruel, a boy whose wild [[behavior]] had exhausted every school in the valley. He did not seem to [[belong]] anywhere. Then a [[benevolent]] carpenter, Mr. Osei, offered him a [[chance]]: help rebuild the storm-damaged clinic. It was a [[challenge]] the boy could not refuse.
ps.zh: 没人相信鲁埃尔，这个男孩的野性子耗尽了山谷里每所学校的耐心。他似乎哪儿都不属于。直到仁慈的木匠奥塞先生给了他一个机会：帮忙重建被风暴损毁的诊所。这个挑战，男孩无法拒绝。

ps.en: Mr. Osei held a simple [[belief]]: honest work can [[change]] a person's [[character]]. He taught Ruel to [[channel]] his anger into hammering and sawing. The work proved [[beneficial]], and slowly the boy learned to [[behave]] around others. Villagers began to see a gentle, almost [[benign]] side of him.
ps.zh: 奥塞先生抱着一个朴素的信念：踏实的劳动能改变一个人的品格。他教鲁埃尔把怒气疏导进锤子和锯子里。劳动确实有益，男孩慢慢学会了如何与人相处。村民们开始看到他温和、近乎善良的一面。

ps.en: The project brought real [[benefits|benefit]] to the village, and the clinic reopened before winter. Reporters [[characterised|characterise]] Ruel's story as typical of the town, where patience was the chief [[characteristic]]. Asked why he stayed, Ruel said the place finally felt like his own.
ps.zh: 这项工程给村子带来了实实在在的好处，诊所在入冬前重新开门。记者们把鲁埃尔的故事描述为这座小镇的典型——耐心正是这里最鲜明的特质。被问及为何留下时，鲁埃尔说，这个地方终于有了家的感觉。

c: celebrate sth with sb 与某人庆祝某事
celebrate an anniversary 庆祝周年纪念
be celebrated as 被誉为
words.dif: celebrate 指举行活动庆祝喜事；congratulate 是向人道贺（后接人）；praise 侧重口头赞美
words.pat: We gather to celebrate not only success, but the effort behind it.
words.patZh: 我们相聚不仅庆祝成功，也庆祝成功背后的努力。

c: a local celebrity 当地名人
a celebrity endorser 代言名人
rise to celebrity 一举成名
words.dif: celebrity 指名人本人或名声；fame 只指名声；star 多指演艺、体育明星
words.pat: A celebrity's words carry weight, so they should speak with care.
words.patZh: 名人的话有分量，因此更应谨言慎行。

c: hold a ceremony 举行典礼
an opening ceremony 开幕式
attend a ceremony 出席仪式
fam: ceremonial adj. 仪式的；礼仪的
words.dif: ceremony 指正式典礼；ritual 偏宗教或习惯性仪式；celebration 偏欢庆活动
words.pat: The award ceremony reminds us that effort deserves public recognition.
words.patZh: 颁奖仪式提醒我们，努力值得被公开肯定。

c: be certain of/about 对……有把握
be certain to do 肯定会做
a certain 某个；某种
for certain 确切地
words.dif: certain 与 sure 常互换，certain 更正式；a certain+名词 表"某个"，不表确定
words.pat: It is certain that those who prepare well will seize the opportunity.
words.patZh: 准备充分的人必定会抓住机会。

c: with certainty 确信地
a matter of certainty 确定无疑的事
absolute certainty 绝对把握
words.dif: certainty 强调确定无疑的事实；confidence 强调主观信心；possibility 是其反义
words.pat: No one can predict the future with certainty, but preparation reduces risk.
words.patZh: 无人能绝对确定地预知未来，但准备能降低风险。

c: award a certificate 颁发证书
a birth certificate 出生证明
a certificate of donation 捐赠证书
words.dif: certificate 泛指证明文件；diploma 专指毕业文凭；license 指执照许可
words.pat: A certificate may open the door, but ability keeps it open.
words.patZh: 证书能敲开门，能力才能让门一直开着。

c: certify that... 证明……
be certified as 被认证为
certify a document 认证文件
words.dif: certify 多指官方书面证明；verify 强调核实真伪；confirm 泛指确认
words.pat: The agency certified that all the funds had reached the school.
words.patZh: 该机构证明所有款项均已送达学校。

c: decline an invitation 谢绝邀请
decline to do sth 拒绝做某事
on the decline 在衰落中
a decline in sales 销量下降
fam: declining adj. 下降的；衰退的
words.dif: decline 谢绝较委婉；refuse 是直接拒绝；reject 语气最强，指断然驳回
words.pat: When sales decline, a company must review its strategy rather than blame the market.
words.patZh: 销量下滑时，公司应反思策略而非责怪市场。

c: decrease by 10% 减少了10%
decrease to 500 减少到500
a decrease in demand 需求减少
words.dif: decrease by 表幅度（减了多少），decrease to 表结果（减到多少），介词别混
words.pat: Regular exercise can decrease the risk of heart disease.
words.patZh: 规律运动可以降低患心脏病的风险。

c: issue a decree 颁布法令
by decree 以法令形式
a royal decree 敕令
fam: decree n./v. 法令；颁布（无常用派生词）
words.dif: decree 是政府颁布的正式法令；decide 是普通"决定"；degree 形近但意为"程度、学位"
words.pat: The government issued a decree banning single-use plastics in public parks.
words.patZh: 政府颁布法令，禁止在公园使用一次性塑料。

c: deem sth (to be) adj. 认为某事……
deem it necessary to do 认为有必要做
be deemed as 被视为
fam: deem vt. 认为（无常用派生词）
words.dif: deem 是正式书面语，用法为 deem+宾语+补语；consider 更通用；think 最口语
words.pat: We deem it our duty to protect the environment for future generations.
words.patZh: 我们认为为后代保护环境是责任所在。

c: dedicate oneself to (doing) sth 致力于……
dedicate sth to sb 把……献给某人
be dedicated to 专注于
fam: dedicated adj. 专注的；献身的
dedication n. 奉献；献身精神
words.dif: dedicate 与 devote 都接介词 to，后接名词或动名词，不接不定式——完形高频考点
words.pat: She dedicated her whole life to improving rural education.
words.patZh: 她毕生致力于改善乡村教育。

c: deduce sth from sth 从……推断出……
deduce that... 推断……
words.dif: deduce 指从原理或证据逻辑推出（演绎）；infer 指从迹象推测；conclude 泛指得出结论
words.pat: From the data, scientists deduced that the climate was changing faster than expected.
words.patZh: 科学家从数据推断，气候变化比预期更快。

c: deduct sth from sth 从……中扣除……
deduct tax from wages 从工资中扣税
words.dif: deduct 多指从钱款中扣除；subtract 指数学相减；deduce 是"推论"，形近义远
words.pat: The fine will be deducted from his monthly salary.
words.patZh: 罚款将从他的月薪中扣除。

c: in fashion 流行
out of fashion 过时
in a...fashion 以……方式
the latest fashion 最新潮流
fam: fashionable adj. 流行的；时髦的
words.dif: fashion 指流行风尚或"方式"；style 指个人风格；trend 指发展趋势
words.pat: True kindness never goes out of fashion.
words.patZh: 真正的善良永不过时。

c: fashionable clothes 时髦服装
a fashionable restaurant 时尚高档的餐厅
it is fashionable to do 做……很流行
words.dif: fashionable 指当下流行的；stylish 指有品位的，未必流行；trendy 更口语
words.pat: It has become fashionable among young people to live a simpler life.
words.patZh: 过更简单的生活在年轻人中已成风尚。

words.exam: 恩惠；偏爱；赞同；支持；拥护
c: do sb a favour 帮某人一个忙
in favour of 支持；赞同
win sb's favour 赢得某人好感
favour A over B 偏爱A甚于B
fam: favorable adj. 赞许的；有利的
words.dif: favour 作名词是恩惠、赞同，作动词是偏爱、支持；in favour of 是完形高频搭配
words.pat: Most citizens are in favour of building more public libraries.
words.patZh: 大多数市民支持建更多公共图书馆。

c: be favorable to/towards 对……有利；赞许
favorable conditions 有利条件
a favorable comment 好评
fam: favorite n. 最喜爱的人或物
words.dif: favorable 指有利的、赞许的；favorite 指最喜欢的；两者同源不同义
words.pat: A favorable wind cannot replace hard rowing, but it makes the journey easier.
words.patZh: 顺风代替不了奋力划桨，但能让航程更顺。

words.exam: 最喜欢的；最喜爱的人或物
c: one's favorite book 某人最喜欢的书
a firm favorite 最受喜爱的人或物
words.dif: favorite 本身已含"最"义，不说 most favorite
words.pat: Reading remains my favorite way to spend a quiet evening.
words.patZh: 阅读仍是我度过安静夜晚最喜欢的方式。

c: sit for an exam 参加考试
sit on a committee 担任委员
sit down 坐下
fam: sitting n. 会期；一次坐着的时间
words.dif: sit 是不及物动词（坐）；seat 是及物动词（使就座），常用 be seated
words.pat: Those who sit on committees should speak for the people they serve.
words.patZh: 在委员会任职的人，应当为自己服务的对象发声。

words.exam: 位置；场所；地点；遗址；使坐落在
c: a historic site 历史遗址
a construction site 工地
on site 在现场
a web site 网站
words.dif: site 指有特定用途的场地或遗址；sight 是"视力、景象"；cite 是"引用"——三词同音必辨
words.pat: The government decided to build a new library on the site of the old factory.
words.patZh: 政府决定在旧工厂旧址上建新图书馆。

words.exam: 使位于；使坐落于；使联系
c: be situated in/on 坐落于
be well situated 位置优越
situate sth in context 把……置于背景中理解
words.dif: situate 常用被动 be situated in/at；locate 同义且更常用；sit 是"坐"，词根同源
words.pat: The school is beautifully situated between the river and the hills.
words.patZh: 这所学校坐落在河与山之间，位置极佳。

c: the current situation 当前形势
in a difficult situation 处境困难
deal with the situation 应对局面
words.dif: situation 指综合的形势、处境；condition 指状态条件；position 指位置或立场
words.pat: In a difficult situation, calm judgment is more valuable than quick action.
words.patZh: 困境之中，冷静判断比快速行动更可贵。

c: a human skeleton 人体骨骼
a skeleton staff 最少人员
the skeleton of a report 报告的纲要
fam: skeletal adj. 骨骼的；骨瘦如柴的
words.dif: skeleton 常考"梗概、框架"僻义；outline 泛指提纲；framework 指结构框架
words.pat: Before writing, draw the skeleton of your argument in a few lines.
words.patZh: 动笔之前，先用几行字搭好论证的骨架。

c: be skeptical of/about 对……怀疑
remain skeptical 持怀疑态度
a skeptical attitude 怀疑态度
words.dif: skeptical 指理性存疑（等证据）；suspicious 指猜疑他人有恶意；doubtful 泛指不确定
words.pat: Stay skeptical of easy answers, for truth usually demands patience.
words.patZh: 对轻易的答案保持怀疑，因为真相往往需要耐心。

c: draw a sketch 画速写
a rough sketch 草图
sketch out a plan 概述计划
fam: sketchy adj. 粗略的；不完全的
words.dif: sketch 作名词是速写草图，作动词可指概述；draft 指文稿草稿；outline 指提纲
words.pat: He sketched out his idea on a napkin, and it later became a great design.
words.patZh: 他在餐巾上勾勒出构想，后来成了伟大的设计。

c: embrace an idea 欣然接受观念
embrace change 拥抱变化
embrace sb in one's arms 拥抱某人
words.dif: embrace 常考"欣然接受"与"包括"两层抽象义；hug 只指身体拥抱；include 仅指包含
words.pat: The wise embrace change instead of fearing it.
words.patZh: 智者拥抱变化，而非畏惧变化。

c: be embedded in 嵌入……中
embed sth in memory 深留记忆
embed a video 嵌入视频
fam: embedded adj. 嵌入的；根深蒂固的
words.dif: embed 强调深埋其中、成为一体；insert 只是插入；root 指扎根
words.pat: Values embedded in childhood often guide a person for life.
words.patZh: 童年深植的价值观往往指引人的一生。

c: embody the spirit of 体现……精神
embody an ideal 使理想具体化
be embodied in 体现在……中
words.dif: embody 指抽象品质具体化、体现于；represent 指代表；express 指表达
words.pat: A good building should embody the culture of the place where it stands.
words.patZh: 好的建筑应体现其所在土地的文化。

c: in embryo 在萌芽中
an embryo of an idea 想法的雏形
embryo research 胚胎研究
fam: embryonic adj. 胚胎的；萌芽期的
words.dif: embryo 常考比喻义"萌芽状态"，in embryo 是固定短语；germ 指微生物或萌芽；bud 指花蕾
words.pat: The plan is still in embryo, but it already shows great promise.
words.patZh: 计划尚在萌芽，但已显露巨大潜力。

c: elicit a response 引出回应
elicit information from sb 从某人处套出信息
elicit laughter 引发笑声
words.dif: elicit 指引出回答、反应；illicit 是同音形近词，意为"非法的"——完形陷阱
words.pat: Good questions elicit honest answers, while pressure only invites silence.
words.patZh: 好的提问引出诚实的回答，压力只会换来沉默。

words.exam: 精英；上层人士；掌权人物；精英的
c: the intellectual elite 知识精英
an elite team 精英团队
elite education 精英教育
words.dif: elite 指群体中最优秀的少数人；expert 指某领域专家；leader 指领导者
words.pat: True elites are measured not by privilege, but by contribution.
words.patZh: 衡量真正的精英，不看特权，看贡献。

c: go elsewhere 去别处
look elsewhere 另寻他处
elsewhere in the world 在世界其他地方
syn: in other places 在其他地方
words.dif: elsewhere 是书面语"在别处"，句中常暗含"这里不行，去别处找"的对比
words.pat: If opportunity is blocked here, be brave enough to look elsewhere.
words.patZh: 此处机会若被堵死，就勇敢地去别处寻找。

c: a thirst for knowledge 求知欲
quench one's thirst 解渴
thirst for power 渴望权力
words.dif: thirst 常考 thirst for+抽象名词 的渴望义；hunger for 同义；desire 通用
words.pat: A thirst for knowledge is the best gift education can give.
words.patZh: 求知欲是教育能给予的最好礼物。

c: a thorough investigation 彻底调查
be thorough in 在……方面一丝不苟
a thorough understanding 透彻理解
words.dif: thorough 指彻底、面面俱到；through 是介词"穿过"；thoughtful 是"体贴的、沉思的"
words.pat: A thorough review of the past is the first step toward real progress.
words.patZh: 彻底复盘过去，是迈向真正进步的第一步。

c: even though 即使
as though 好像
句末 though 表"不过"
fam: thoughtful adj. 沉思的；体贴的
words.dif: though 可作副词放句末表转折（"不过"），although 不能；although 引导从句不倒装
words.pat: Small though the shop was, it held the memories of the whole street.
words.patZh: 店虽小，却装着整条街的记忆。

c: give thought to 考虑
at the thought of 一想到……
deep in thought 陷入沉思
second thought 再三考虑
fam: thoughtful adj. 体贴的；沉思的
words.dif: thought 指想法、思考过程；idea 指具体主意；thinking 指思维方式
words.pat: Give some thought to others before you speak, and words will carry warmth.
words.patZh: 开口前多为别人着想，言语才会有温度。

c: be thoughtful of sb 体贴某人
a thoughtful gift 贴心的礼物
a thoughtful look 沉思的神情
words.dif: thoughtful 双义：体贴的（=considerate）与沉思的；thoughtless 是其反义"欠考虑的"
words.pat: A thoughtful leader listens more than he speaks.
words.patZh: 善思的领导者多听少说。

c: pose a threat to 对……构成威胁
under threat 受到威胁
a threat to security 安全威胁
words.dif: threat 是名词"威胁"；threaten 是动词；danger 指客观危险，threat 常含人为意图
words.pat: Climate change poses a real threat to coastal cities around the world.
words.patZh: 气候变化对全球沿海城市构成真实威胁。

c: threaten to do sth 威胁要做某事
threaten sb with sth 用……威胁某人
be threatened with extinction 濒临灭绝
words.dif: threaten 既可指恐吓，也可指（危险）逼近，如 Rain threatens；intimidate 只指恐吓人
words.pat: When difficulties threaten our plans, we adjust the route, not the goal.
words.patZh: 困难威胁计划时，我们调整路线，而非目标。

c: update sth with sth 用……更新……
keep sb updated 让某人了解最新情况
a software update 软件更新
words.dif: update 是动词、名词"更新"；up-to-date 是形容词"最新的"；upgrade 指升级（质的提升）
words.pat: We must update our knowledge constantly, for the world refuses to stand still.
words.patZh: 世界不停下脚步，我们必须不断更新知识。

c: upgrade the system 升级系统
upgrade sb to 把某人升级到
an upgrade to the service 服务的升级
words.dif: upgrade 指升级换代；update 指更新内容；improve 泛指改进
words.pat: Investing in education is the surest way to upgrade a nation's future.
words.patZh: 投资教育是提升国家未来最可靠的方式。

c: uphold the law 维护法律
uphold a principle 坚持原则
uphold a decision 维持原判
words.dif: uphold 指维护法律、原则、裁决；support 泛指支持；hold up 是"举起、耽搁"，别混
words.pat: A society that upholds fairness earns the trust of its people.
words.patZh: 维护公平的社会才能赢得人民的信任。

words.exam: 使心烦意乱；打乱；搅乱；打翻
c: be upset about/over 为……难过
upset the plan 打乱计划
upset a glass 打翻杯子
words.dif: upset 常考"打乱（安排）"与"使难过"两义；过去式、过去分词仍是 upset，不规则变化
words.pat: Do not let one failure upset your whole plan; adjust and move on.
words.patZh: 别让一次失败打乱全盘计划，调整之后继续前行。

c: up-to-date information 最新信息
keep sth up-to-date 使……保持最新
up-to-date equipment 现代化设备
words.dif: up-to-date 作定语带连字符；out of date 表"过时"；update 是动词
words.pat: An up-to-date map is useless to a traveler who refuses to leave home.
words.patZh: 地图再新，对不肯出门的旅人也毫无用处。

c: ventilate a room 给房间通风
well-ventilated 通风良好的
a ventilating system 通风系统
fam: ventilator n. 通风设备；呼吸机
words.dif: ventilate 本义"使通风"，引申"公开讨论（问题）"；air 作动词也可表"发表（意见）"
words.pat: Open the windows and ventilate the room before the meeting begins.
words.patZh: 开会前先开窗给房间通通风。

c: a joint venture 合资企业
venture into 冒险进入
venture to do 敢于做
fam: adventurous adj. 爱冒险的（近形）
words.dif: venture 常指有风险的事业、投资；adventure 指惊险经历；joint venture 是经贸高频词
words.pat: Every great venture begins with a small, brave step into the unknown.
words.patZh: 每个伟大的事业，都始于向未知迈出的勇敢小步。

c: widespread concern 普遍关注
widespread use 广泛使用
widespread support 广泛支持
words.dif: widespread 指大范围分布的；common 指常见的；extensive 指范围广大的
words.pat: The widespread use of smartphones has changed how we remember things.
words.patZh: 智能手机的普及改变了我们记忆事物的方式。

c: win a prize 获奖
win sb's trust 赢得信任
win over 争取过来
a big win 大胜
fam: winning adj. 获胜的；迷人的
words.dif: win 后接比赛、奖项、人心；beat/defeat 后接对手——宾语不同是考点
words.pat: Kind words can win hearts that force can never reach.
words.patZh: 善意的话语能赢得武力无法触及的人心。

c: have the wit to do 有做……的才智
at one's wits' end 智穷计尽
quick wit 机智
words.dif: wit 指机智、急智；wisdom 指智慧（深厚判断力）；intelligence 指一般智力
words.pat: Her quick wit saved the company from an embarrassing situation.
words.patZh: 她的机智让公司免于一场尴尬。

c: withdraw money 取款
withdraw from 退出……
withdraw a statement 收回言论
words.dif: withdraw 过去式 withdrew、过去分词 withdrawn；deposit（存钱）是其反义动作
words.pat: Knowing when to withdraw is as important as knowing when to advance.
words.patZh: 知道何时撤退，与知道何时前进同样重要。

c: a witness to the accident 事故目击者
bear witness to 为……作证
witness sth 目睹某事
words.dif: witness 指目击者且常作动词；wit 是"机智"；bystander 只是旁观者，未必作证
words.pat: History will witness the efforts of this generation.
words.patZh: 历史将见证这一代人的努力。

c: inaugurate a president 为总统举行就职典礼
inaugurate an era 开创时代
be inaugurated as 就任
fam: inauguration n. 就职典礼；开创
inaugural adj. 就职的；开幕的
words.dif: inaugurate 指隆重地开始、开创；begin 最通用；launch 指推出产品或计划
words.pat: The new library was inaugurated to mark the city's two-hundredth birthday.
words.patZh: 新图书馆落成启用，以纪念建市两百周年。

c: an incentive to do sth 做某事的激励
give sb an incentive 给某人动力
economic incentives 经济激励
fam: incite v. 煽动；激励（同根）
words.dif: incentive 是外部诱因、奖励；motivation 是内在动机；motive 指行为动机
words.pat: A good incentive can turn passive students into active learners.
words.patZh: 好的激励机制能把被动的学生变成主动的学习者。

c: the incidence of disease 疾病发生率
a high/low incidence 高/低发生率
reduce the incidence of crime 降低犯罪率
words.dif: incidence 是发生率（抽象统计）；incident 是事件（具体一件事）；accident 是事故
words.pat: Better public health care has reduced the incidence of many diseases.
words.patZh: 更好的公共医疗降低了许多疾病的发病率。

c: a minor incident 小事件
an isolated incident 孤立事件
report the incident 报告该事件
words.dif: incident 多指不寻常甚至冲突性的事件；event 泛指大事或活动；accident 强调意外事故
words.pat: One careless incident can destroy a reputation built over years.
words.patZh: 一次疏忽的事件，足以毁掉多年建立的声誉。

c: incidentally 顺便说一句（句首/句中转换话题）
mention sth incidentally 顺带提到某事
syn: by the bye 顺便提一下
words.dif: incidentally 是书面化的"顺便一提"，口语多用 by the way；与 accidentally（意外地）形近义异
words.pat: Incidentally, the library will stay open later during the exam week.
words.patZh: 顺便提一句，考试周图书馆会延迟闭馆。

c: be inclined to do 倾向于做
incline to/towards 倾向于
an incline 斜坡
words.dif: incline 常考 be inclined to do（倾向于）；tend to do 更通用；decline 是"下降、谢绝"，形近义反
words.pat: I am inclined to believe that habit shapes destiny more than talent does.
words.patZh: 我倾向于相信，习惯比天赋更能塑造命运。

c: academic research 学术研究
academic performance 学业表现
an academic year 学年
words.dif: academic 指学术的（也含"纯理论的"意味）；theoretical 指理论上的；scholarly 指有学者风范的
words.pat: Academic knowledge gains real value only when it serves real life.
words.patZh: 学术知识只有服务现实生活，才有真正的价值。

c: a military academy 军校
the academy of sciences 科学院
an art academy 艺术学院
words.dif: academy 多指专科院校或权威学术团体；college 泛指学院；university 指综合性大学
words.pat: The academy has trained generations of scientists for the country.
words.patZh: 这所学院为国家培养了一代又一代科学家。

c: accelerate the process 加速进程
accelerate growth 加快增长
economic acceleration 经济加速
words.dif: accelerate 指加快速度、进程；speed up 更口语；decelerate 是反义"减速"
words.pat: Reading good books can accelerate a young person's growth.
words.patZh: 读好书能加速年轻人的成长。

c: accept sth as 接受……为
accept an invitation 接受邀请
widely accepted 被广泛认可的
words.dif: accept 是主观"接受"；receive 是客观"收到"——收到邀请未必接受，经典辨析
words.pat: Learn to accept what cannot be changed, and to change what should not be accepted.
words.patZh: 学会接受无法改变的，改变不应接受的。

c: gain acceptance 获得认可
an acceptance speech 获奖感言
social acceptance 社会认同
words.dif: acceptance 是 accept 的名词，指接受、认可；reception 指接待、反响；admission 指准许进入
words.pat: True acceptance of others begins with accepting yourself.
words.patZh: 真正接纳他人，始于接纳自己。

words.exam: 接近；进入；接近（或进入）的机会；入口；存取；访问
c: have access to 有使用……的机会
access to information 获取信息
gain access to 得以进入
fam: accessible adj. 易接近的；可使用的
words.dif: access 后固定接 to（have access to）；assess 是"评估"，形近必辨；entrance 指入口
words.pat: Equal access to education is the foundation of a fair society.
words.patZh: 平等的教育机会是公平社会的基石。

c: fashion accessories 时尚配饰
car accessories 汽车配件
an accessory to a crime 从犯
fam: access n./v. 进入；访问（同根异形）
words.dif: accessory 指配件、附属物（法律上指从犯）；access 是"进入、使用权"，形近义远
words.pat: Small accessories, chosen with care, can brighten a simple outfit.
words.patZh: 精心挑选的小配饰能点亮一身素装。

c: begin with 以……开始
begin to do/doing 开始做
to begin with 首先
words.dif: begin 与 start 常互换，start 更口语；commence 是正式用语；过去式 began、过去分词 begun 别写错
words.pat: Every great achievement begins with the decision to try.
words.patZh: 每个伟大的成就都始于"决定尝试"的那一刻。

c: at the beginning of 在……之初
from beginning to end 从头到尾
a new beginning 新的开始
words.dif: at the beginning of 指时间、过程的起点；in the beginning 指"起初"（暗示后来有变）
words.pat: A good beginning is half the battle, but persistence wins the war.
words.patZh: 好的开始是成功的一半，但坚持才赢得全程。

c: on behalf of 代表；为了……的利益
speak on sb's behalf 替某人发言
fam: behalf n. 代表；利益（无常用派生词）
words.dif: behalf 几乎只活在 on behalf of 里；in behalf of 是美式旧用法"为……的利益"，别混淆
words.pat: On behalf of all the students, I would like to thank our teachers.
words.patZh: 我谨代表全体学生，感谢我们的老师。

c: behave oneself 守规矩
behave well/badly 表现好/差
behave towards sb 对待某人
words.dif: behave 是不及物动词（表现、守规矩）；conduct oneself 更正式；act 泛指行动
words.pat: How we behave when no one is watching shows who we really are.
words.patZh: 无人注视时我们的举止，才显露真实的自己。

c: good/bad behavior 良好/不良行为
social behavior 社交行为
change one's behavior 改变行为
words.dif: behavior 泛指行为举止，常作不可数；conduct 是正式用语；action 指具体动作
words.pat: Small acts of good behavior, repeated daily, become a person's character.
words.patZh: 日常重复的微小善行，会沉淀为一个人的品格。

c: hold a belief 持有信念
beyond belief 难以置信
in the belief that 坚信……
words.dif: belief 是名词（注意拼写 ie）；believe 是动词；faith 更偏宗教或深厚信任
words.pat: Belief in oneself is the first secret of success.
words.patZh: 自信是成功的第一秘诀。

c: believe in 信任；信仰
believe it or not 信不信由你
make believe 假装
words.dif: believe sb 是相信某人说的话；believe in sb/sth 是信任某人、相信某事存在或有价值
words.pat: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
words.patZh: 未来属于相信梦想之美的人。

c: belong to 属于
belong in/with 应归入
a sense of belonging 归属感
syn: be part of 是……的一部分
words.dif: belong to 不用于进行时和被动语态——语法高频考点；own 是"拥有"，主客体相反
words.pat: This victory belongs to everyone who never gave up.
words.patZh: 这场胜利属于每一个不曾放弃的人。

c: be beneficial to 对……有益
mutually beneficial 互惠的
a beneficial effect 良好效果
words.dif: beneficial to 后接事物；helpful 后接人或事均可；harmful 是其反义
words.pat: Reading is beneficial to both the mind and the character.
words.patZh: 阅读对心智和品格都有益处。

words.exam: 利益；好处；受益于；救济金；奖金；补贴
c: benefit from 从……中受益
be of benefit to 对……有益
for the benefit of 为了……的利益
unemployment benefits 失业救济金
words.dif: benefit from 主语是受益者；benefit 作及物动词时主语是施益方，如 The policy benefits farmers.
words.pat: The new policy will benefit millions of families in rural areas.
words.patZh: 新政策将使农村数百万家庭受益。

c: a benevolent smile 慈祥的微笑
a benevolent fund 慈善基金
a benevolent act 善举
words.dif: benevolent 是书面"仁慈的"；kind 通用；charitable 偏慈善捐助的
words.pat: A benevolent heart notices needs that others pass by.
words.patZh: 仁慈的心能注意到旁人忽略的难处。

c: a benign tumor 良性肿瘤
a benign climate 宜人的气候
a benign influence 良好的影响
words.dif: benign 最常考医学义"良性的"（反义 malignant 恶性的）；形容人时=和蔼的，与 benevolent 近义
words.pat: The doctor smiled benignly and told him the shadow was benign.
words.patZh: 医生和蔼地笑着告诉他，那个阴影是良性的。

words.exam: 向……挑战；对……质疑；挑战；艰苦的任务
c: face a challenge 面对挑战
challenge sb to do 激励某人做
pose a challenge 构成挑战
beyond challenge 无可置疑
words.dif: challenge 常考"质疑"义（challenge an idea）；defy 指公然违抗；dare 指"敢"
words.pat: We should challenge old ideas, not the people who hold them.
words.patZh: 我们应质疑陈旧的观念，而非持有观念的人。

words.exam: 机会；可能性；偶然性；碰巧；偶然发生
c: take a chance 碰运气；冒险一试
by chance 偶然
a chance to do 做……的机会
the chances are 很可能
words.dif: chance 指机会，也含偶然性；opportunity 专指好机会；by chance 是固定短语
words.pat: Give every child a chance, and society will harvest talent beyond imagination.
words.patZh: 给每个孩子一个机会，社会将收获超乎想象的人才。

c: change sth into 把……变成
change one's mind 改变主意
a change for the better 好转
small change 零钱
words.dif: change 泛指改变；alter 指局部修改；transform 指彻底转变——程度递进
words.pat: Be the change you wish to see in the world.
words.patZh: 欲变世界，先变自身。

c: through official channels 通过官方渠道
a news channel 新闻频道
channel energy into 把精力引向
words.dif: channel 常考"渠道、途径"与动词"疏导"义；canal 是"运河"；tunnel 是"隧道"
words.pat: Great teachers channel their students' energy toward creation, not destruction.
words.patZh: 好老师把学生的精力引向创造，而非破坏。

words.exam: 特性；品质；性格；人物；角色；符号；汉字
c: build character 塑造品格
a main character 主角
in character 符合本性
Chinese characters 汉字
words.dif: character 义项极多（性格/人物/汉字），阅读看语境；personality 只指个性；role 只指角色
words.pat: Adversity reveals character; it does not build it from nothing.
words.patZh: 逆境显露品格，而非凭空造就品格。

c: be characterised by 以……为特征
characterise sth as 把……描述为
words.dif: characterise 是英式拼写，美式为 characterize；be characterised by 是阅读高频被动结构
words.pat: The report characterises the decade as one of rapid change.
words.patZh: 报告将这十年描绘为剧变的十年。

c: a characteristic of 是……的特征
be characteristic of 为……所特有
typical characteristics 典型特征
words.dif: characteristic 作名词是"特征"，作形容词"特有的"常接 of；feature 指外在特征；trait 指性格特质
words.pat: Patience is characteristic of all great craftsmen.
words.patZh: 耐心是所有伟大工匠共有的特质。
